title: Human experience emerges intelligibly from simpler experience

statements.text: Once the base is experiential, emergence regains respectability: human or sea snail experience emerges from experience of another kind, as liquidity emerges from what is not liquid. Matter with experiential and non-experiential features organized into ever more complex forms of both, including by natural selection.

sources.quote: the notion of emergence begins to recover some respectability in its application to the case of experience
so too there was spectacular enlargement and fine-tuning of experiential forms
